title: aigent-OS: day one
ariaLabel: First Claude Code session after install: the operator-setup conversation, three plain questions leading to a first plan.

turns.speaker: ai
lines: I'm your AIgent operator. Let's get you one real win in the next few minutes.
In a sentence or two, what's your business, or the work you want help running?

turns.speaker: you
lines: I run a bookkeeping practice for trades: electricians, plumbers, HVAC.

turns.speaker: ai
lines: Got it. What's the one outcome that would make this month a win?

turns.speaker: you
lines: Five new clients, without working weekends.

turns.speaker: ai
lines: And what do you spend the most time on that you wish just ran itself?

turns.speaker: you
lines: Chasing leads. I'm always the one following up.

turns.speaker: ai
lines: Here's what I know about you: you run a bookkeeping practice for trades, you want five new clients this month without working weekends, and chasing leads eats your time.
1. Draft a week of outreach to local trade businesses, so lead-chasing runs without you.
2. Build a "new client" intake that collects everything you need before the first call.
3. Turn last month's finished jobs into three referral asks.
Pick one and we'll do it right now.
